conviction_note: A First North microcap trading at about 60x ARR (16.83m shares x SEK 6.60 = ~SEK 111m against SEK 1.77m ARR). It doubled on the Fortnox launch story, which the Q3 numbers cannot carry because the product opens on 1 November. There is no estimate to beat, the cash pile is shrinking and nothing has been pre-released. The size is large (10%: new numbers, $123k a day, 132% realised vol) but the sign is close to a coin (p_up 46). The findings sum (-1.2) and the scaled number (-0.8) agree in sign; both are small because every finding is an inference against an unsourced bar.

Investor presentation of Aira for Fortnox (14 Oct; recording published 16 Oct): no customer, ARR or sign-up numbers given

Cash at 30 Sep. On Q2's burn (operating cash flow -4.1, capitalised development 1.2 MSEK) it is roughly SEK 9-10m, before the heavier Q4 marketing push. Expected to raise runway questions; mildly negative
No formal guide exists. The 100 MSEK ARR in three years ambition may be reiterated and is unlikely to move
Possibly the first count of Fortnox early-access / golden-ticket applications (programme opened 15 Oct, after quarter end). Upside if disclosed; unknown whether it will be

findings.finding: Q3 is the last quarter before Aira for Fortnox exists commercially (it opens to all Fortnox customers on 1 Nov; early access began 15 Oct). So the reported ARR is the HubSpot/standalone base off SEK 1.77m, against a SEK ~111m market cap that more than doubled on the Fortnox story; the print cannot validate the story it is priced on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: One prior print: the Q2 report (2026-07-17, ARR 1.8 MSEK) took the stock from 3.55 to 3.40, -4.2% on the day (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.original_quote: Den 1 november öppnar Aira for Fortnox för alla Fortnox kundbolag. Innan dess släpps ett begränsat antal bolag in. (On 1 November Aira for Fortnox opens to all Fortnox customer companies. Before then a limited number of companies are let in.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock already fell about 18% from its 10-12 peak after the investor presentation. With no estimates, nobody has published what Q3 ARR should be. If the market were treating Q3 as a non-event, the pre-report fade would have stopped; it was still falling on 10-16 (7.18 to 6.60).
findings.independence: The Q2 report gives the ARR base (KSEK 1,767) and says the first Aira Connect paying customer was signed in early July: https://storage.mfn.se/235f4e56-c739-42ab-b9e1-4f1649ae481b/aira-interim-report-q2-2026.pdf

findings.finding: Cash was SEK 14.3m at 30 June on a quarterly operating cash burn of SEK 4.1m plus SEK 1.2m of capitalised development, and Q3/Q4 add a paid DI advertorial, an investor event and an eight-city seminar tour. Q3 cash is likely about SEK 9-10m, roughly two quarters of runway, which the release will make visible. The company has said this is 'more than sufficient to carry Aira to profitability'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. No financing has been announced since listing.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 cash figure is not public. A doubled share price is when a pre-profit microcap raises money, and the report was brought forward four days. If the market had priced a raise, the stock would trade with a discount around a likely placing price; instead it holds about 60x ARR. Financing is a question, though: money raised would buy the Fortnox go-to-market, so the sign is uncertain and the size is held small.
findings.independence: The spend corroborating a higher Q3/Q4 burn: the seminar tour (https://mfn.se/a/aira/aira-publicerar-alla-detaljer-om-aira-for-fortnox-och-presenterar-lanseringsturne) and the DI paid content 'Innehåll från Aira Annons', published 2026-10-09 (https://www.di.se/brandstudio/ai-utmanaren-hjalper-fortnox-kunder-att-hitta-nya-affarer-i-den-egna-datan/)

findings.finding: The golden-ticket early-access programme for Aira for Fortnox opened on 15 Oct, four days before the report, so the release and 09:00 call are the first place management can quantify early Fortnox demand (applications, activations). A company in heavy promotion mode is likely to cite such a number if it is flattering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. The Fortnox announcement itself (2026-09-29) started a run from 3.97 to 8.05 over nine sessions.
findings.original_quote: Den som ansöker på aira.app/fortnox får sin guldbiljett per mejl, installerar Aira i Fortnox appmarknad och löser in koden vid första inloggningen. (Anyone who applies at aira.app/fortnox gets a golden ticket by email, installs Aira from the Fortnox app market and redeems the code at first login.)
findings.why_not_priced: No demand number has been published: the 10-14 investor presentation gave the TAM and the go-to-market but no counts. A priced demand number would show as a stable or rising price into the report; instead the stock faded 18% after the presentation.
findings.independence: The company has invested heavily in investor communication around the launch (investor presentation, recording, podcasts, Kalqyl interview): https://mfn.se/a/aira/aira-publicerar-inspelningen-fran-investerarpresentationen-av-aira-for-fortnox

outside_window.finding: Aira for Fortnox opens to all of Fortnox's 600,000+ customer companies on 1 Nov, with a seminar tour 12 Nov to 3 Dec; the first real ARR test is the Q4 report

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative, in line with the run-up-only lean (-3.4) after a +67% 20-day run, so they mostly agree with what the free control already says. The upside finding (Fortnox demand counts) is the one cutting against it.
language_note: The Swedish releases are word-for-word twins of the English ones (Aira publishes both on MFN); the bring-forward and golden-ticket facts are in both languages.
Only the domestic press showed that the DI piece is paid content ('Innehåll från Aira Annons'), which corroborates the promotion-driven spend behind finding 2.
The Swedish commissioned initiation (Kalqyl, 18 Aug) is what establishes that there are no estimates ('har valt att avvakta med finansiella estimat'); no English source states it.
lessons_applied: 'Financing is a question, not a verdict': the cash/runway finding went from -1.5 to -1.0, since any money raised would fund the Fortnox ramp
Bar unsourced, so every finding is capped: the ARR-versus-story finding went from -1.5 to -1.0
Inferred content of the release: the Fortnox-demand finding was trimmed from +1.0 to +0.8
'Size the move on what is new; the reaction history moves p_up': abs_move_pct stays 10 (new numbers, thin, 132% vol) and p_up moved from 45 to 46 because one prior reaction is not a pattern
